sourceText:
Coffee Banana Bread
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:59am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups melted butter
1 3/4 cups sugar
4 eggs
3 teaspoons vanilla
1/2 teaspoon almond extract
1 grated orange rind
2 cups mashed bananas, (ripe)
2 cups whole wheat flour
2 cups white flour
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
3 teaspoons baking powder
1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
1 cup strong black coffee

Preparation

1 Stir the melted butter in with the sugar. Beat the 4 eggs separate then add eggs and extract with grated orange rind. Beat until smooth. Sift together flours, add salt, baking soda, baking powder, spices. Sift all dry ingredients if desired. 2 Take the mashed ripe bananas and place in medium-sized bowl. Pour the strong black coffee over them and let them soak 5 to 10 minutes. 3 Stir together all ingredients. Bake in preheated oven at 350 degrees in greased 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until cake tester inserted comes out clean.
